insights.insight: $4.59M in cumulative GMV across 85,608+ cryptographically verified receipts establishes a real transaction corpus — not modeled or inferred spend, but confirmed purchase events with a structural intake pace of ~453 receipts per day over the past 106 days.

Probabilistic ad targeting pays $5+ CPM to infer purchase intent from browsing behavior; a verified receipt is a confirmed transaction — the gap between inference and cryptographic proof is where deterministic audience segments are built.

Pre-rollover 7-day GMV peaks have climbed on five consecutive days — $94.3K, $94.9K, $98.8K, $99.3K, $101.3K — with the $101K reading marking the first confirmed breach of the $100K weekly threshold, driven by genuine evening receipt volume, not a data artifact.

insights.topic: Category breadth across grocery and home improvement
insights.insight: Four new brands crossed the visibility threshold within 48 hours — Safeway, Aldi, Whole Foods Market, and Lowe's — joining Walmart (348 receipts), Costco (160), Kroger (157), and Home Depot (60 combined); the pattern confirms multi-vertical coverage rather than concentration in a single category.

insights.topic: Throughput acceleration against a rising comparison base
insights.insight: Week-over-week velocity was 0.825x at last clean reading, but acceleration held above 1.0x for ten consecutive heartbeats — meaning receipt volume is growing even as it compounds against an increasingly strong prior-week baseline.

insights.topic: Settlement cadence as data reliability signal
insights.insight: 738 confirmed on-chain payouts totaling 14,426,987 sats provide an auditable settlement trail that brand measurement teams can use to validate receipt authenticity independently of the platform's own reporting.
